newsitem.title: USA: Medical Technology sells Kentucky unit.
newsitem.headline: Medical Technology sells Kentucky unit.

text.p: Medical Technology Systems Inc said on Monday it had sold its subsidiary, Vangard Labs Inc in Glasgow, Ky., and that proceeds from the sale would go toward reducing indebtedness to its principal lender.

Under the agreement, certain assets of Vangard will be sold for about $3.2 million in cash. The agreement also allows for the assumption of certain liabilities of about $820,000, Medical Technology said.
The sale of Vangard was contemplated in a plan of reorganization confirmed in September, the company said.

"Working in cooperation with our lender, we have accomplished each of the objectives established last year when we submitted our plans," said Todd Siegel, president and chief executive of Medical Technology.

Medical Technology Systems Inc manufactures and markets proprietary medication packaging and dispensing systems and clinical information systems. The company did not specify who had bought Vangard Labs Inc.
